example_en: Planting trees can help [mitigate] the effects of urban heat.
example_zh: 植树有助于缓和城市热岛效应。

example_en: A [substantial] number of students chose to study abroad.
example_zh: 相当多的学生选择了出国留学。

example_en: This disease was once [prevalent] in tropical regions.
example_zh: 这种疾病曾经在热带地区盛行。

example_en: She bought [comprehensive] insurance before the long trip.
example_zh: 长途旅行前她买了综合保险。

example_en: Farmers are learning more [sustainable] ways to use water.
example_zh: 农民正在学习更可持续的用水方式。

example_en: The school became a [paradigm] for rural education reform.
example_zh: 这所学校成了乡村教育改革的典范。

example_en: Strict rules [constrain] how teachers design their exams.
example_zh: 严格的规定约束着教师出题的方式。

example_en: The study found a [disparity] in test scores between the two schools.
example_zh: 研究发现两所学校的考试成绩存在差距。

example_en: The group continues to [advocate] free education for all children.
example_zh: 该团体继续主张所有儿童享有免费教育。

example_en: As an [advocate] for clean energy, he gives talks at schools.
example_zh: 作为清洁能源的拥护者，他在学校做讲座。

example_en: Their conclusions rest on years of [empirical] research.
example_zh: 他们的结论建立在多年的实证研究之上。

example_en: Fresh fruit is [abundant] in the local market in autumn.
example_zh: 秋天当地市场上新鲜水果很丰富。

example_en: The new subway line should [alleviate] traffic jams downtown.
example_zh: 新地铁线应能缓解市中心的交通拥堵。

example_en: The novel describes the life of an [adolescent] in a small town.
example_zh: 这部小说描写了一个小镇青少年的生活。

example_en: He moved to the city with great [ambition] and little money.
example_zh: 他怀着远大抱负、带着很少的钱来到这座城市。

example_en: Please [amend] the date on the form before you submit it.
example_zh: 提交前请修改表格上的日期。

example_en: The survey is [anonymous], so please answer honestly.
example_zh: 这项调查是匿名的，请如实回答。

example_en: The order of the names on the list is [arbitrary].
example_zh: 名单上的姓名是随意排列的。

example_en: Praise can [boost] a child's confidence.
example_zh: 表扬能增强孩子的自信。

example_en: The new law aims to cut [bureaucracy] in public services.
example_zh: 新法旨在减少公共服务中的繁文缛节。

example_en: Be [cautious] when you share personal information online.
example_zh: 在网上分享个人信息时要谨慎。

example_en: She will always [cherish] the memory of her first trip abroad.
example_zh: 她会一直珍藏第一次出国旅行的回忆。

example_en: My first attempts at dancing were slow and [clumsy].
example_zh: 我最初学跳舞时又慢又笨拙。

example_en: Talks between the two companies may [collapse] if neither side gives way.
example_zh: 如果双方都不让步，两家公司的谈判可能破裂。

example_en: In the desert, clean water is a precious [commodity].
example_zh: 在沙漠里，干净的水是珍贵的商品。

example_en: The two roommates were not [compatible] and argued often.
example_zh: 两个室友合不来，经常争吵。

example_en: Hard work can [compensate] for a lack of talent.
example_zh: 勤奋可以弥补天赋的不足。

example_en: Teenagers often feel pressure to [conform] to their friends.
example_zh: 青少年常常感到要与朋友保持一致的压力。

example_en: His [contempt] for the rules got him into trouble.
example_zh: 他对规则的蔑视让他惹上了麻烦。

example_en: The family has continued to [cultivate] this land for generations.
example_zh: 这家人世代耕种这片土地。

example_en: Successful sales staff [cultivate] long relationships with customers.
example_zh: 成功的销售人员会与客户建立长期关系。

example_en: Try to [devote] at least an hour a day to English.
example_zh: 每天尽量至少花一小时学英语。

example_en: Doctors face a moral [dilemma] when resources are limited.
example_zh: 资源有限时医生面临道德困境。

example_en: The museum displays an [elaborate] model of the ancient city.
example_zh: 博物馆展出了一座精心制作的古城模型。

example_en: Repeated lies will [erode] public trust.
example_zh: 反复撒谎会逐渐削弱公众的信任。

example_en: Scammers [exploit] people's fear to steal their money.
example_zh: 骗子利用人们的恐惧骗取钱财。

example_en: Engineers found a way to [exploit] wind energy on the island.
example_zh: 工程师找到了在岛上开发风能的方法。

example_en: The engineers found a [feasible] solution to the water shortage.
example_zh: 工程师们找到了解决缺水问题的可行方案。

example_en: Her mood tends to [fluctuate] before exams.
example_zh: 考试前她的情绪容易起伏。

example_en: Poor eyesight can [hinder] a child's learning.
example_zh: 视力不好会妨碍孩子的学习。

example_en: Climbing Everest takes [immense] courage.
example_zh: 攀登珠峰需要极大的勇气。

example_en: Volunteers have become an [indispensable] part of the event.
example_zh: 志愿者已成为这项活动不可或缺的一部分。

example_en: Trust is an important [ingredient] of friendship.
example_zh: 信任是友谊的重要组成部分。

example_en: Curiosity is [inherent] in young children.
example_zh: 好奇心是幼儿与生俱来的。

example_en: Workers have a [legitimate] reason to ask for a pay rise.
example_zh: 工人们要求加薪有正当理由。

example_en: Social media tends to [magnify] small problems.
example_zh: 社交媒体往往会夸大小问题。

example_en: Teachers sometimes [mediate] when students argue.
example_zh: 学生争吵时老师有时会出面调解。

example_en: The hotel charges a [modest] fee for parking.
example_zh: 酒店收取适度的停车费。

example_en: The city was once [notorious] for its polluted air.
example_zh: 这座城市曾因空气污染而声名狼藉。

example_en: Try to stay [optimistic] even when things go wrong.
example_zh: 即使事情不顺也要尽量保持乐观。

example_en: Do not let one bad grade [overwhelm] you.
example_zh: 不要因为一次成绩不好就不知所措。

example_en: The tower is the most [prominent] building on the skyline.
example_zh: 这座塔是天际线上最突出的建筑。

example_en: The school has [rigid] rules about uniforms.
example_zh: 学校对校服有严格的规定。

example_en: Their views on the plan [coincide] on most points.
example_zh: 他们对计划的看法在大多数方面一致。

example_en: It is impolite to [contradict] your teacher in front of the class.
example_zh: 当着全班的面反驳老师是不礼貌的。

example_en: Safety was the main [criterion] for selecting the site.
example_zh: 安全是选址的主要标准。

example_en: Can you [deduce] the meaning of the word from its context?
example_zh: 你能根据上下文推断出这个词的意思吗？

example_en: Relations between the two countries continued to [deteriorate].
example_zh: 两国关系持续恶化。

example_en: The auditor noticed a [discrepancy] in the accounts.
example_zh: 审计员发现账目中有不一致之处。

example_en: The team was [dominant] throughout the second half.
example_zh: 这支球队在下半场一直占据主导。

example_en: The contract makes it [explicit] that payment is due monthly.
example_zh: 合同明确规定按月付款。

example_en: Good lighting can [facilitate] reading in the classroom.
example_zh: 良好的照明有助于在教室里阅读。

example_en: The army has a strict [hierarchy] of ranks.
example_zh: 军队有严格的等级制度。

example_en: Economic [ideology] shaped the reforms of the 1980s.
example_zh: 经济思想体系影响了二十世纪八十年代的改革。

example_en: A high price does not always [imply] high quality.
example_zh: 高价并不总是意味着高质量。

example_en: The app can [integrate] data from several devices.
example_zh: 这个应用可以整合多台设备的数据。

example_en: There must be a [rational] explanation for the strange noise.
example_zh: 这种奇怪的声音一定有合理的解释。

example_en: The government introduced [legislation] to ban plastic bags.
example_zh: 政府出台法规禁止使用塑料袋。

example_en: Poor families often live in [marginal] areas of the city.
example_zh: 贫困家庭往往住在城市的边缘地带。

example_en: Each lesson starts with a clear learning [objective].
example_zh: 每节课都以明确的学习目标开始。

example_en: The report gives an [objective] account of the accident.
example_zh: 这份报告客观地叙述了这次事故。

example_en: The story ends with a strange [paradox] that puzzles readers.
example_zh: 故事以一个令读者困惑的奇怪悖论结尾。

example_en: Many people [perceive] the city as unsafe at night.
example_zh: 许多人认为这座城市夜里不安全。

example_en: The northern lights are a natural [phenomenon] caused by the sun.
example_zh: 北极光是由太阳引起的自然现象。

example_en: The detective found no [plausible] motive for the crime.
example_zh: 侦探找不到合理的犯罪动机。

example_en: There is little [prospect] of rain this week.
example_zh: 本周几乎没有下雨的可能。

example_en: The company needs [radical] changes to survive.
example_zh: 公司需要根本性的变革才能生存。

example_en: The minister tried to [refute] the claims made in the newspaper.
example_zh: 部长试图驳斥报纸上的说法。

example_en: Workers used steel bars to [reinforce] the old wall.
example_zh: 工人用钢筋加固了旧墙。

example_en: Every claim in the paper must survive [scrutiny] by other experts.
example_zh: 论文中的每个观点都必须经得起其他专家的审查。

example_en: Problems in [subsequent] years showed that the plan was flawed.
example_zh: 随后几年出现的问题表明这个计划有缺陷。

example_en: She made a [subtle] change to the recipe.
example_zh: 她对食谱做了细微的改动。

example_en: The government sent troops to [suppress] the riot.
example_zh: 政府派军队镇压了暴乱。

example_en: The scientists reached only a [tentative] conclusion.
example_zh: 科学家们只得出了一个初步结论。

example_en: Architects plan to [transform] the old factory into an art centre.
example_zh: 建筑师计划把旧工厂改造成艺术中心。

example_en: The city will [undergo] major changes in the next decade.
example_zh: 未来十年这座城市将经历重大变化。

example_en: The new design can [utilize] solar energy more efficiently.
example_zh: 新设计能更有效地利用太阳能。

example_en: Scientists repeated the test to [verify] the results.
example_zh: 科学家们重复实验以证实结果。

example_en: The court will decide on the [validity] of the contract.
example_zh: 法院将裁定合同的有效性。

example_en: The committee failed to reach a [consensus] on the budget.
example_zh: 委员会未能就预算达成共识。

example_en: Your final grade is based on [cumulative] scores from the whole term.
example_zh: 你的期末成绩基于整个学期的累计分数。

example_en: Trust is a [prerequisite] for any successful team.
example_zh: 信任是任何成功团队的前提。

example_en: Some students find it hard to [retain] new vocabulary.
example_zh: 有些学生觉得很难记住新词汇。

example_en: Good teachers [stimulate] students' curiosity.
example_zh: 好老师会激发学生的好奇心。

example_en: Public transport should be safe and [affordable].
example_zh: 公共交通应当安全且价格合理。

example_en: Climate change is a serious threat to [agriculture].
example_zh: 气候变化对农业构成严重威胁。

example_en: Building roads through forests can reduce [biodiversity].
example_zh: 在森林中修路会减少生物多样性。

example_en: The school spent most of its [budget] on new computers.
example_zh: 学校把大部分预算花在了新电脑上。

example_en: They stayed in a [budget] hotel near the station.
example_zh: 他们住在车站附近的一家经济型酒店。

example_en: The company aims to cut its [carbon] emissions by 2030.
example_zh: 公司计划在 2030 年前减少碳排放。

example_en: The new bridge has reduced [congestion] in the city centre.
example_zh: 新桥缓解了市中心的拥堵。

example_en: Water [conservation] is important in dry areas.
example_zh: 在干旱地区节约用水很重要。

example_en: The restaurant serves traditional French [cuisine].
example_zh: 这家餐厅供应传统法国菜。

example_en: The new [dormitory] has a kitchen on every floor.
example_zh: 新宿舍每层都有厨房。

example_en: Strict rules limit the [emission] of smoke from chimneys.
example_zh: 严格的规定限制烟囱排放烟雾。

example_en: More adults [enrol] in evening classes every year.
example_zh: 每年有更多成年人报名上夜校。

example_en: Many languages are in danger of becoming [extinct].
example_zh: 许多语言面临消亡的危险。

example_en: Farmers moved to the area because the land was [fertile].
example_zh: 农民因为这里土地肥沃而搬来。

example_en: Coal is a [fossil] fuel formed from ancient plants.
example_zh: 煤是由古代植物形成的化石燃料。

example_en: The film industry has been changed by [globalisation].
example_zh: 电影业因全球化而改变。

example_en: Bread goes mouldy quickly in [humid] conditions.
example_zh: 面包在潮湿的环境里很快发霉。

example_en: Good [infrastructure] attracts foreign companies.
example_zh: 完善的基础设施吸引外国公司。

example_en: Without [irrigation], the desert farms would fail.
example_zh: 没有灌溉，沙漠农场将无法经营。

example_en: Reading is my favourite [leisure] activity.
example_zh: 阅读是我最喜欢的休闲活动。

example_en: Please arrive before the [lecture] starts.
example_zh: 请在讲座开始前到场。

example_en: It is no use trying to [lecture] teenagers about their clothes.
example_zh: 为穿着问题对青少年说教没有用。

example_en: Young people [migrate] to cities to look for work.
example_zh: 年轻人移居到城市找工作。

example_en: The course teaches basic [nutrition] and cooking skills.
example_zh: 这门课程教授基础营养知识和烹饪技能。

example_en: Lack of exercise is one cause of [obesity].
example_zh: 缺乏锻炼是肥胖的原因之一。

example_en: Every [pedestrian] must use the bridge to cross the motorway.
example_zh: 每位行人都必须走天桥穿过高速公路。

example_en: The [questionnaire] was sent to five hundred families.
example_zh: 这份调查表发给了五百户家庭。

example_en: The airline promised a full [refund] for the cancelled flight.
example_zh: 航空公司承诺对取消的航班全额退款。

example_en: The country gets half its electricity from [renewable] sources.
example_zh: 该国一半电力来自可再生能源。

example_en: Heavy lorries are banned from [residential] streets at night.
example_zh: 夜间禁止重型卡车驶入居民区街道。

example_en: The university offers a [scholarship] for students from poor families.
example_zh: 大学为贫困家庭的学生提供奖学金。

example_en: I am taking four courses this [semester].
example_zh: 这学期我选了四门课。

example_en: This key ring is a [souvenir] from my trip to Japan.
example_zh: 这个钥匙扣是我去日本旅行带回的纪念品。

example_en: House prices in this [suburb] are lower than in the centre.
example_zh: 这个郊区的房价比市中心低。

example_en: Mass [tourism] can damage historic sites.
example_zh: 大规模旅游会破坏历史遗迹。

example_en: Air pollution is a serious [urban] problem.
example_zh: 空气污染是严重的城市问题。

example_en: Every child should receive the measles [vaccine].
example_zh: 每个孩子都应接种麻疹疫苗。

example_en: As a [vegetarian], he never eats fish or meat.
example_zh: 作为素食者，他从不吃鱼和肉。

example_en: The company plans to train its entire [workforce] in safety.
example_zh: 公司计划对全体员工进行安全培训。

example_en: Plastic waste in the ocean harms [wildlife].
example_zh: 海洋中的塑料垃圾危害野生动物。

example_en: The region suffers a severe [drought] almost every summer.
example_zh: 该地区几乎每年夏天都遭遇严重干旱。

example_en: Turn off every electrical [appliance] before you go on holiday.
example_zh: 去度假前把所有电器都关掉。
